messages:
Sam (AE): Quick handoff 1 TapWave (enterprise). Closing today but two open items: SSO not validated + on-prem connector not in their infra queue. Renewal will be at risk if not live before billing. Can CS take ownership and coordinate eng?
Rina (CSM): Ill take the lead. Need IdP cert + metadata and the infra contact who will run the connector. Also what env (staging/prod) do they want us to test against?
Nora (Sales Ops): Renewal window is 30d. Finance can offer a conditional retention credit (15%) if onboarding completes within 14d of renewal. That requires Support sign-off on connector deploy readiness.
Diego (Support Eng): I can look at the connector Mon/Tue. @Rina please paste the IdP metadata and the public IP/CIDR theyll use for the agent. Also any existing connector logs.
Maya (Onboarding): I'll prep enablement docs and a runbook template. Propose a 60-min session Tue 10am PT (prefer) or Wed 2pm PT.
Sam (AE): Tara (infra lead) is the runner: tara@tapwave.ai. They want prod validation but are OK with a staged cutover. Sam to confirm ingress IP and whether outbound 443 is allowed.
Rina (CSM): Tara confirmed outbound 443 allowed. Sharing IdP metadata XML below and redirect URI.
Rina (CSM): ```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.tapwave.ai">...snip metadata xml...
```
Rina (CSM): Redirect URI: https://app.tapwave.ai/_redwood/sso/callback
Diego (Support Eng): Good. Ill create a ticket and a short sanity-check script for the connector. Drop the resolver IP if you can so I can curl the callback.
Sam (AE): IP is 198.51.100.22. Also customer notes: theyve seen latency spikes on long prompts and are worried about cost. Put that on the agenda.
Maya (Onboarding): Will add agenda: SSO verification, connector install, perf baseline + cost mitigation (batching/cache/quant).
Diego (Support Eng): Ticket CS-4987 created and assigned to me. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4987
deploy-bot: Ticket CS-4987 created by Diego.
Diego (Support Eng): Next steps Im tracking: 1) Rina upload cert/metadata + connector logs by EOD, 2) Ill prep connector package and a minimal sanity script by Mon EOD, 3) Maya sends invite for Tue 10am PT, 4) Sam confirms finance credit path with Nora.
Rina (CSM): Running curl test against callback now and will paste headers.
Rina (CSM): ```
curl -I -X GET 'https://app.tapwave.ai/_redwood/sso/callback' --resolve 'app.tapwave.ai:443:198.51.100.22'
```
Rina (CSM): Response: HTTP/2 200; server: nginx; cache-control: no-cache
Diego (Support Eng): Awesome. Thats what I need. Ill add redirect to playbook and prep config snippet.
Nora (Sales Ops): If perf concern persists post-onboarding we can propose a pilot/discount for 60d. Logging as a renewal-mitigation option.
Sam (AE): I'll communicate the Tue plan and conditional credit to Tara and legal. If anything blocks the Tue slot, escalate to Emily (Head of CS) and mark renewal high risk.
Rina (CSM): Acknowledged. Ill capture all this in the success plan doc and tag owners.
Maya (Onboarding): Once Diego confirms playbook upload Ill send the calendar invite. :calendar:
